'''Utsushikoo no Mikoto''' (内色許男命) is a figure in ancient {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|qid=Q17|lt=Japan}}, identified as the progenitor of the {{ill|Hozumi clan|ja|穂積氏|qid=Q11597079}} and referred to as "Utsushikoo no Mikoto" in the ''{{ill|Kojiki|en|Kojiki|qid=Q813031|lt=Kojiki}}'' and as "Utsushikoo no Mikoto" (欝色雄命) in the ''{{ill|Nihon Shoki|en|Nihon Shoki|qid=Q813935|lt=Nihon Shoki}}.''

== Overview ==
In the ''Kojiki'' entry for {{ill|Emperor Kōgen|en|Emperor Kōgen|qid=Q333572|lt=Emperor Kōgen}}, Utsushikoo no Mikoto is described as the elder brother of the emperor’s consort, {{ill|Utsushikome|ja|欝色謎命|lt=Utsushikome no Mikoto}}, and as the father of {{ill|Ikagashikome|ja|伊迦賀色許売命}}, whom Emperor Kōgen later married. However, traditions associating Ikaga Shikome no Mikoto as the daughter of Utsushikoo no Mikoto are not found in sources other than the ''Kojiki.'' The ''Nihon Shoki'' refers to Utsushikoo as the brother of Utsushikome no Mikoto and founder of the Hozumi clan.

Although the ''Kojiki'' and ''Nihon Shoki'' provide limited accounts of his activities, the ''{{ill|Kujiki|en|Kujiki|qid=Q2716751|lt=Sendai Kuji Hongi}}'' states that in the 8th year of Emperor Kōgen’s reign, Utsushikoo no Mikoto was appointed as Grand Minister (Ōomi), while his brother {{ill|Ōhesoki|ja|大綜杵命}} was made Chief Minister (Ōnori).
